# @babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx-self

> Add a __self prop to all JSX Elements

See our website [@babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx-self](https://babeljs.io/docs/babel-plugin-transform-react-jsx-self) for more information.

## Install

Using npm:

```sh
npm install --save-prod @babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx-self
```

or using yarn:

```sh
yarn add @babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx-self --prod
```
